holder_baseline.how_to_read: If the holder's own prior transactions are confirmed fraud, this holder identity is compromised: matching its baseline is evidence FOR fraud, not against it. A holder is defined by card, billing region and anchor day, so its history is always in its own region: whether the region is new can only be read at card level (alert_context.card_history.flagged_region_share_of_card).

shared_origin.how_to_read: lift = share of transactions on this element scoring >= 0.5, divided by the same share across all transactions. Large regions and common email domains carry many unrelated cards; a shared origin needs lift well above 1 and several distinct cards.
